shots.beat: Welcome to 2196: a slow tilt up from the overgrown avenue (trees in the road, a temporal zone glowing on it) to the tower canyon of Rain City a hundred and forty-seven years on: vines on the facades, the fallen tower face leaning across the avenue, haze and a slit of morning sky.
shots.characters: none (the Reach itself; Kai stands at the landing, too small and shaded to read)
shots.lighting: Morning haze from the far end of the avenue, vines on the sunlit tower, the zone's cold glow; the near tower in shade.
shots.sound: 2196 bed: processed wind, birds, a far bell. Sera's line over it.
shots.notes: g5: a tilt-up reveal along the avenue axis (camera 16-18 m up, above the canopy, pushing 7 m north) instead of the storyboard's oblique aerial, whose two near tower walls filled two thirds of the frame. Descending into the canopy was tried and rejected (tree crowns crossing the lens, the shaded road reads as a dark mass). Kai is not featured: from any height above the trees he is a dark speck on the shaded road; s18 carries him.

preview.note: g5 final: tilt-up from the overgrown avenue and the glowing zone to the vine-hung tower canyon and the sky slit.

shots.beat: The memorial square: Kai walks away from the lens toward a bronze statue of himself standing in the ring of a machine, and lifts his head to its face; the plaque below reads KAI VAREN · ARCHITECT OF THE FRACTURE.

setup.eval: (()=>{const s=__m14.W.lightSrc.find(s=>s.p[0]===-8&&s.p[2]===-51); if(s){s.p=[-8,1.9,-49.0]; s.i=2.6; s.d=7;} Object.defineProperty(__game.player,'camYaw',{configurable:true,get(){return 0},set(v){}}); return 'plaque lamp moved: '+!!s})()

(async()=>{const T=await import('/vendor/three.module.min.js'); const L=new T.SpotLight(0xffe2c0,60,30,0.35,0.6,1.5); L.position.set(-5.5,3.5,-44); L.target.position.set(-8,5,-54.7); __game.scene.add(L,L.target); return 'statue key on'})()

shots.characters: Kai (back to camera, walking in from beside the lens, stopping right of the plaque and looking up); the bronze statue
shots.lighting: Low angle against the morning sky; a warm run-time key on the bronze from the camera side so it reads as metal, not a silhouette; the plaque lamp moved 2 m forward and up (it burned out a flower bunch beside the plaque).
shots.notes: g5: Kai walks on the touch stick (0.3 = walk) with player.camYaw pinned to 0 for the shot (the game's camera yaw drifts behind a moving Kai and bent his path onto the plaque). He stops at t 2.7 right of the plaque, in front of the east bush. Focus on the statue's head: Kai walks from soft into the focal plane. The memorial cutscene's trigger is registered later in the mission, so the square is free to stage.

preview.note: Strong: Kai under his own statue, plaque legible.

shots.beat: Montage: Halden General's reversed East Corridor: a gurney, a cylinder and glass fly back to where they were at 08:14.
shots.characters: Kai at the threshold (edge of frame)
shots.lighting: Hospital corridor in night emergency light; the reversal chevrons on the floor; debris travelling backward.
shots.notes: The corridor's hazards cycle (land, return, hold) on their own schedule; check the strip that one is in flight.

preview.note: Debris in flight with the reversal rings; the corridor itself is plain.

shots.beat: Montage: Dr. Yara Lind, stopped mid-stride inside the containment field for three days.

preview.note: Strong: Yara frozen mid-stride inside the containment rings.

shots.beat: Montage: the Eastway at night, the sea of 2196 poured into 2049's highway.
shots.characters: none (the stalled N4 bus far down the road)
shots.lighting: Night rain on flood water, wrecked traffic, highway lights.

preview.note: Night highway with wrecked traffic in rain; the flood is not legible at preview size.

shots.beat: Montage: the Corran Building, its upper floors torn away by the storm.
shots.lighting: Looking up the broken tower into storm light.
shots.notes: ?m18part=4 is mission 18's own chapter start (development switch); nothing from later missions is loaded.

shots.beat: Montage: the storm front bearing down on Lantern Hall as its anchor fails.
shots.lighting: Violet storm light over the iron trusses.

preview.note: Lantern Hall trusses under violet storm light.
